claim_text: Results indicated a significant improvement in conformance with ISO14001:2015.
metric_name: EMS audit conformance; EMS audit partial conformance; EMS audit non-conformance
context_text: Northern Star states that an external FY25 EMS audit indicated significant improvement in conformance with ISO14001:2015. The chart on the same page shows FY22 EMS Audit results of 42% conformance, 33% partial conformance, and 25% non-conformance, versus FY25 results of 93% conformance, 7% partial conformance, and 0% non-conformance.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: FY25与FY22 EMS审计对比图给出了明确的改善幅度，直接支持“significant improvement in conformance”。
notes: 证据包含同页正文与审计结果图表。
